subject.title: [Feature]: Feishu: send text + multiple images as a single interactive card

question: Should Feishu text/presentation plus image attachments automatically collapse into one interactive image card, or require an explicit Feishu-scoped opt-in?
rationale: The implementation boundary is clear, but the default behavior changes existing Feishu send semantics and the final image-card safety limits need owner intent.

options.title: Opt-in image cards
options.body: Add a Feishu-scoped opt-in first so existing text-plus-media sends keep sequential behavior unless the sender requests a card.

options.title: Automatic image cards
options.body: Automatically compose one card whenever Feishu sends include text or presentation plus image attachments, with sequential fallback on upload or card failure.

options.title: Wait for generic image presentation
options.body: Defer this until the cross-channel presentation contract grows an image block instead of adding a Feishu-first path.

recommendation.title: Opt-in image cards
recommendation.body: Add a Feishu-scoped opt-in first so existing text-plus-media sends keep sequential behavior unless the sender requests a card.

likelyOwner.reason: The package metadata names @m1heng as the Feishu plugin community owner, and this is a Feishu-only product behavior choice.
